Read the complete admission Owner and every product call site. Fixed shapes are private detached snapshots with typed properties and Owner serialization. Selection, ownership, history digest, complete recipient Run/Assistant witnesses, clone provenance and missing/null rejection have a single validator; no dictionary compatibility interface remains. Dynamic storage/Engine consumers use the existing transaction and validated bindings; the public stored schema and error text are unchanged.
